_comment: Placeholder content overlay. The real values live in content.local.json (git-ignored). recipe_categories maps each act a prompt can depict to the distinctive substrings that mark it; detector_labels are the aim model's class names, anchor_classes being the subset the aim point tracks; suite_root is the folder holding the media library and the third-party apps such as ComfyUI. project_roots is optional: the folders holding the suite's own app checkouts, searched in order, for when they do not live under suite_root/projects; omit it and that is exactly where they are looked for. genau_source names the inbox folder Origenerator drops a Genau clip in, which is how Evolver knows to upscale it and deliver the result to Genau rather than leave it in the outbox; it lives here rather than in source because naming a folder inside the library makes that name library vocabulary, which the sanitize harvester then blocks. Evolver reads the same key from its own overlay and the two must agree. ambient_audio_dir is optional too: the library folder the toolbar's audio switch shuffles clips out of, sound only, relative to suite_root unless it is absolute; omit it and that switch simply stays silent. combine_recipes is optional as well: an act named here pins the gallery's Combine to this hand-tuned workflow+params (any param unnamed falls to the workflow's defaults, seeds are re-rolled per launch) instead of mining a recipe from past videos — the way out when an act's past videos all share a weakness. genau_recipes is the same table for Combine's Genau lane, which makes one looping stroke rather than a full-length video: the key is the act again, so the two tables are separate — one keyed by act alone could hold an act's long-form recipe or its loop, never both. Both are optional, and an act missing from one is mined from past videos instead (for the Genau lane, only from videos a looping workflow made). detail_fix_parts is optional: extra parts the spoken "fix <part>" command can aim the enhance's detail pass at, beyond the built-in faces/hands/teeth/eyes — name is the word captions use, spoken the words the command may say, matches the filename substrings that recognize an installed detector (under ComfyUI's models/ultralytics/bbox) as finding it. search_synonyms is optional: extra groups of interchangeable words for the gallery search, each group a list of single words that all satisfy a query for any other — the built-in table in origenerator/search.py is general English, so vocabulary describing the library itself goes here. A group sharing a word with a built-in group extends it rather than replacing it; multi-word entries are ignored, since matching is word by word.
